question: Who among the following was appointed as Ombudsman and Ethics Officer of the Board of Control for Cricket in India in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Arun Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Arun Mishra was appointed as the Ombudsman and Ethics Officer of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in January 2025.
 
• The Ombudsman and Ethics Officer position in BCCI is crucial for addressing disputes and ethical issues within the organization.
 
• Justice Arun Mishra is a former Supreme Court judge known for his significant judgments during his tenure.
 
• His appointment reflects the BCCI’s commitment to ensuring transparency and ethical governance in Indian cricket administration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ombudsman Role:**

 
 
• An Ombudsman is an independent official appointed to investigate complaints and disputes within organizations.
 
• In the context of BCCI, the Ombudsman handles issues related to players, officials, and stakeholders in cricket.
 
 
 
• **Ethics Officer Role:**
 
 
• The Ethics Officer ensures adherence to ethical practices and addresses conflicts of interest within the BCCI.
 
• This role is vital for maintaining the integrity of cricket administration and governance.
 
 
 
• **BCCI Governance:**
 
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India is the governing body for cricket in India, responsible for organizing domestic and international matches.
 
• It operates under guidelines set by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
 
 
• **Judiciary and Cricket Administration:**
 
 
• Retired judges are often appointed to key roles in sports governance to bring impartiality and legal expertise.
 
• Such appointments aim to ensure fair decision-making and conflict resolution within sports organizations.
